scripts.dev: REMOTE_HOST=209.182.232.165; CURRENT_IP=$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null); ENV_FILE=$([ "$npm_config_prod" = 'true' ] && echo .env.prod || [ "$CURRENT_IP" = "$REMOTE_HOST" ] && echo .env.prod || echo .env.local); echo "[dev] Using $ENV_FILE"; set -a && source $ENV_FILE && set +a; PORT_TO_KILL=${PORT:-3003}; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[dev] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.api: APP_ENV=$([ "$npm_config_prod" = 'true' ] && echo prod || echo ''); export APP_ENV; PORT_TO_KILL=8003; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[api] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; cd apps/api && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT_TO_KILL
